# `flip_calibration`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Flip the active RA calibration.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x73db0 (64-bit build), MyDev::FlipRACal @0x93bb0 |

Params are not consumed. Calls the device layer to flip the active RA-axis calibration and related configuration state. Result is integer 0 on success; failure is reported as 207. Downstream subtype-specific validation and error paths are unresolved. The method is registered in the guider command table (TCP 4400); a request that reaches the main imager and is relayed to the guider is a separate route with its own side effects, outside this entry's tier.

Side effects: Flips the active RA calibration and calibration-related configuration state.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 207 | The flip operation reported failure | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Native error paths below the device layer are not enumerated; callee-set codes are not established.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":3,"method":"flip_calibration"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"flip_calibration","result":0,"code":0,"id":3}
```

Reply, error-207:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"flip_calibration","error":"fail to operate","code":207,"id":4}
```
